howItWorks.title: How e-Samadhan AI Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From complaint submission to resolution — our AI handles everything in between.

steps.title: Citizen Submits Complaint
steps.desc: Citizens file complaints via web, mobile app, or SMS in their preferred language with photos and location.

steps.title: AI Detects Department & Priority
steps.desc: Our NLP engine classifies the complaint, assigns priority level, and routes it to the correct department instantly.

steps.title: Officer Gets Notified Instantly
steps.desc: The assigned officer receives real-time alerts with full complaint details, location map, and SLA deadline.

steps.title: Problem Gets Resolved Quickly
steps.desc: Officer resolves the issue, uploads proof, and the citizen gets notified. Feedback loop closes the complaint.

testimonials.title: Trusted by Millions of Citizens
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from real people whose civic issues were resolved through e-Samadhan AI.

priya.name: Priya Sharma
priya.text: I filed a complaint about a broken streetlight and it was fixed within 6 hours! The real-time tracking kept me informed at every step. Truly revolutionary.

rajesh.name: Rajesh Kumar
rajesh.text: The pothole outside my shop was causing accidents for months. After filing on e-Samadhan AI, the roads department responded in 2 days. Incredible platform!

anita.name: Anita Patel
anita.text: Filing in Gujarati was so easy! The AI understood my complaint perfectly and routed it to the right department. This is what digital India should look like.

irfan.name: Mohammed Irfan
irfan.text: Water supply issue in our village was resolved in 3 days after I submitted on e-Samadhan. The officer called me personally. Never experienced this before.

sunita.name: Sunita Devi
sunita.text: The garbage collection in our area was irregular for weeks. One complaint on e-Samadhan and the schedule was fixed permanently. Highly recommend!

arjun.name: Arjun Nair
arjun.text: As someone in tech, I appreciate the AI routing and analytics. The platform is well-designed, fast, and actually works. Government tech done right!

chatbot.greeting: Hi! I am e-Samadhan AI assistant. How can I help you today?
chatbot.replyElectricity: For electricity issues: Create Complaint → select Electricity department, describe outage location, add photo of affected area.
chatbot.replyWater: Water complaints go to Water Supply department. Use emergency toggle if flooding is severe.
chatbot.replyPolice: For crime or safety: use Emergency Complaints for fastest response, or Police department.
chatbot.replyTrack: Go to Track Complaint and enter your ID (e.g. C-000001) to see live timeline.
chatbot.replyEmergency: Emergency mode is for fire, accident, medical crisis. It alerts officers immediately.
chatbot.replyDefault: I can help you file complaints, track status, or use emergency mode. Try asking about electricity, water, or tracking.
